question: The ______ Amendment to the Constitution of India envisaged the Gram Sabha as the foundation of the Panchayat Raj System.
solution:
The correct answer is __**73rd.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **73rd Amendment** to the Constitution of India was passed in** 1992** and it added a new** Part IX to the Constitution, **which deals with **Panchayats.**
 
• This amendment envisaged the** Gram Sabha** as the foundation of the Panchayat Raj System.
 
• Gram Sabha is a body consisting of all persons registered as** voters in a village** or in a **group of villages** within a Panchayat area.
 
• The Panchayat Raj System is a** three-tier system** of local self-government in India, consisting of the** village level** (Gram Panchayat), **intermediate level **(Panchayat Samiti), and** district level **(Zilla Parishad).
 
• This amendment also made it mandatory to hold regular elections to Panchayats** every five years** and reserved seats for **Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes,** and women in Panchayats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **76th Amendment **deals with the incorporation of the** Konkani, Meitei, and Nepali languages** in the** Eighth Schedule **to the Constitution.
 
• **79th Amendment** extended the reservation of seats for **Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes** in the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies for another **ten years,** i.e.,** till 2020.**
 
• **71st Amendment** provided for the creation of a** new State of Uttarakhand** from the existing State of Uttar Pradesh.
